verdict.rationale: Community Phone is documented as a US-only home and business phone service, covering all 50 states with unlimited calling within the US. Nothing in the evidence shows numbers available in other countries or any per-country documentation requirements. The porting paperwork (PIN, account number, Letter of Authorization) covers transferring an existing number, not provisioning new numbers by country, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As a support leader, I can get numbers in the countries my customers call, with each country's documentation requirements stated up front
